query: INSERT INTO user_totp (user_id, secret_ciphertext, secret_nonce, wrapped_key, key_id) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET secret_ciphertext = $2, secret_nonce = $3, wrapped_key = $4, key_id = $5, last_used_step = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE user_totp.enabled_at IS NULL
